name: Prem Mandir, Vrindavan
summary: Prem Mandir — a contemporary Vrindavan landmark known for carved leela panels and evening lights.
famousFor: Illuminated modern marble temple of Braj
mythology: Prem Mandir, Vrindavan at Vrindavan, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh is dedicated to Radha–Krishna (Jagadguru Kripalu Parishat), known especially for Illuminated modern marble temple of Braj. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Radha–Krishna (Jagadguru Kripalu Parishat) blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
